ben: Kicking off a staged apply for release microwave -> staging. Target window 01:30 PT. Tagging @maya-qa for signoff. Will drain the staging pool before apply.

maya-qa: On it. Can you drop the plan link? I'll run quick checks.

ben: plan here: https://ci.internal/reports/microwave/staging/plan-1729001234 
Here's the important diff snippet:
```
# terraform plan -out=tfplan
+ resource "aws_kms_key" "customer_data" { rotation_enabled = true }
~ resource "aws_iam_role" "service_account_proxy" { assume_role_policy = <<POLICY ... }
```

sam-eng: Quick scan — IAM change is limited to adding a condition to service_account_proxy trust. Not adding wildcard perms. kms key rotation will re-alias, not create new external access.

elena-ops: FYI we must drain the staging GPU pool before this apply to avoid KV cache mismatch. Run `./ops/drain-staging.sh` and wait for the node count to settle for 5m. Also annotate the rollout in the console.

ben: deploybot preflight request: `deploybot preflight --env staging --tag microwave/b101`

deploybot: Preflight started for microwave/b101 on staging. Found: 1 non-blocking route53 drift (ttl mismatch), 0 critical security policy diffs. Gate: CLOSED until drifts are addressed or overridden. To override: `deploybot override --env staging --reason "drift benign" --by elena-ops` (audit will record).

maya-qa: I'm fixing the TTL drift now (quick dns reconcile). Will push patch and re-run plan.

maya-qa: TTL fixed and pushed -> commit 8f3a7c. Re-ran plan; diffs identical to previous.

ben: Good. Rollforward plan: drain -> apply -> smoke tests -> un-drain. Rollback plan (if apply fails):
- run `git checkout refs/tags/release/microwave/b100` and `terraform apply -var-file=rollback.tfvars` from the pinned state
- restore kms alias to previous key id (`aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/customer_data --target-key-id <old-key-id>`)
- revert IAM trust change and reapply
- run `./ops/restore-staging-traffic.sh` to reset routing
Please keep the runbook open during the apply.

sam-eng: Adding runbook checklist: backup terraform state (`terraform state pull > state-backup-1729001234.json`), snapshot DBs, and note which pods to restart post-rollback.

tj: When you drain, please also mark the deploybot traffic-split to 0 for canary: `deploybot hold-route --env staging --route microwave-canary`. That will prevent traffic flapping during KV cache changes.

elena-ops: Done. Drain in progress (nodes cordoned). Estimated 7m to quiesce.

ben: Once drain completes I'll trigger `deploybot apply --env staging --plan tfplan` and monitor. If anything unexpected, I'll run the rollback steps and ping oncall.

deploybot: Apply started at 1729001405 for microwave/b101 (staging). Preflight ok. Streaming logs: https://ci.internal/logs/microwave/1729001405

maya-qa: Running smoke tests against staging after apply. Will report failures here.

sam-eng: :thumbsup:
